The '''Phr'sha system''' was located in the [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] technique known as the [[Phr'shan maneuver]].<ref name="Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Phr'shan maneuver]]|system=Phr'sha [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Phr'sha [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
